description: This file implements a SOCKS proxy server and client logic, including connection handling, pattern matching for proxy rules, and event-driven communication for socket requests, data, and errors.

classes.name: SocksConnection
classes.description: Handles individual SOCKS protocol connection, including authentication, request parsing, and data forwarding.

classes.name: SocksProxy
classes.description: Implements a SOCKS proxy server, managing incoming connections, pattern matching, and event emission.

classes.name: SocksProxyHandler
classes.description: Manages SOCKS client requests, establishing network sockets, and emitting events for connection lifecycle.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the pattern for proxy rule matching.

methods.name: _handleDirect
methods.description: Handles direct network connection requests bypassing the proxy.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the listening port of the proxy server.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the proxy server listening on a specified port and hostname.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the proxy server and all active connections.

methods.name: onSocketRequested
methods.description: Handles incoming socket request events, either proxying or direct connection.

methods.name: onSocketData
methods.description: Handles incoming data from network sockets.

methods.name: sendSocketData
methods.description: Sends data through a specific socket identified by uid.

methods.name: sendSocketEnd
methods.description: Ends a socket connection identified by uid.

methods.name: sendSocketError
methods.description: Reports an error on a socket identified by uid.
